BiblicalUsage: If thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place, and Jacob put a space betwixt drove and drove as he sent his gifts before him.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God makes room where there is none, and the enlargement comes from another place when we will not make it ourselves.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
